Male boards 5 1/2 x 2 1/4 in, female 4 1/2 x 2 in.","provenance":"recoloured from rank-senior-brigadier-general-1in-thread: bullion silver (2d Lt and Major gold, others silver, matching the metal and thread forms); bullion texture drawn as a diagonal line pattern","colours":{"bullion":"#c6cbd1","bullion_line":"#8f969e","bullion_edge":"#7d848c"},"anchors":{"top_center":[47.55,0],"bottom_center":[47.55,90.45],"center":[47.55,45.23],"left_edge":[0,45.23],"right_edge":[95.11,45.23],"insignia_center":[47.55,45.23],"rank_slot_center":[47.55,45.23],"mount_center":[47.55,45.23]},"dimensions":{"form":"metal bullion grade insignia (mess dress shoulder board)","insignia_w_in":0.9511,"insignia_h_in":0.9045,"star_diameter_in":1,"points":5,"thread":"silver bullion","slot_fit":{"garment_rank_slot_in":{"along":1.5,"across":1.2},"piece_along_in":0.904,"piece_across_in":0.951,"scale_to_garment_slot":1,"note":"placement rule: leaf stem / stacked stars along the board, bars across, Colonel eagle wingspan along the board; scale < 1 only if the piece must stay inside the slot"}},"mounts":[{"uniform":"Men's mess dress shoulder boards (garment-mess-dress-male-officer-shoulder-boards)","rule":"centred on the board with the board centre line, as close to the shoulder seam as possible; board 5.5 x 2.25 in, 1/2 in dark blue lace each side (general officer boards: silver lace with 1/2 in blue lace), button at the peak (4.1.1.1.1.1, Fig A5-3). Lt Col / Major stem points away from the collar, Colonel eagle beak forward (4.1.1.1.1.2-3). No distance from the board end is given by CAPR 39-1 or DAFI 36-2903; use the garment rank_slot centre."},{"uniform":"Women's mess dress shoulder boards (garment-mess-dress-female-officer-shoulder-boards)","rule":"centred on the board with the board centre line, as close to the shoulder seam as possible; board 4.5 x 2 in, 1/4 in blue lace each side on every grade (Fig A5-3), no button (4.1.2.1.1.1, Fig A5-3). Lt Col / Major stem points away from the collar, Colonel eagle beak forward (4.1.1.1.1.2-3). No distance from the board end is given by CAPR 39-1 or DAFI 36-2903; use the garment rank_slot centre."}],"rank":{"grade":"Brigadier General","abbrev":"Brig Gen","membership":"senior"},"grade":"rank-insignia","size_in":{"w":0.9511,"h":0.9045}}
